Pool | Sleeps 12 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Sea Sanctuary, a luxurious third-floor condo in Seacrest Beach. This spacious, 1,800 sq. ft. condo occupies the entire third floor and features an elevator for easy access. With 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, Sea Sanctuary is the perfect getaway for multiple families or groups, offering plenty of space and modern amenities. OUTDOOR LIVING & POOL Enjoy access to a massive 12,000 sq. ft. tropical pool. Relax and unwind on any of the three private balconies, the first balcony offering a spacious area for dining and lounging while overlooking the pool. The second balcony provides a small ocean view, perfect for watching the sunset, while the third balcony is ideal for sipping your morning coffee at the cozy cafe table.
